name: Bokoblin
desc: A primitive goblin that wields crude weapons. Common in plains.

name: Moblin
desc: A large, horned monster. Much stronger than Bokoblins.

name: Lizalfos
desc: A lizard-like warrior with quick attacks and elemental abilities.

name: Lynel
desc: A fearsome centaur warrior. One of the strongest monsters in Hyrule.

name: Guardian
desc: Ancient Sheikah machine corrupted by Calamity Ganon.

name: Darknut
desc: An armored knight with powerful sword and shield attacks.

name: Wizzrobe
desc: A magical creature that attacks with elemental spells.

name: Hinox
desc: A giant cyclops that sleeps during the day. Extremely powerful.

name: Molduga
desc: A massive sand worm that hunts by sensing vibrations.

name: Talus
desc: A living rock creature disguised as a pile of stones.
